result_summary.title: OAuth Service failing: Login issues, missing MFA, and code rejections
result_summary.description: We are seeing a wave of failures with the OAuth Service in our LATAM production environment. About 38 users are reporting that they cannot log in at all. For those who do get past the first step, the MFA prompt is often not appearing, and when it does, the codes are frequently rejected. This seems to be a core issue with how the OAuth Service is handling the authentication handshake.
